xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: The financial results of the Group for the quarter and 6 months ended 30 September 2024 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors in their respective meetings held on 29 October 2024. The results have also been reviewed by the Statutory Auditors. These consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the Ind AS as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, alongside other generally accepted accounting principles in India. They comply with the presentation and disclosure requirements outlined in Reg 33 of the SEBI LODR. On 27 August 2024, the Company successfully raised funds through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP), allotting 8,022,388 equity shares of face value Rs2 each to eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIB) at a price of Rs536 per share (including a premium of Rs534 per share), totalling Rs430 million. This issue was conducted in accordance with the SEBI ICDR.As stated in the QIP placement document, the Company estimated QIP expenses of approximately Rs1,944.04 lakhs, most of which have been incurred, including applicable taxes. These expenses have been appropriately adjusted from the Securities Premium account. As of 30 September 2024, around Rs8,400 lakhs of the QIP proceeds have been utilized for the intended purposes outlined in the placement document.The BOD has proposed an interim dividend of Rs1.65 per equity share of Rs2 each. The Group has identified its operating segments based on business operations: Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Others (refer to Annexure-I: Segment Information).The reviewed quarterly financial results for the Group and the Company for the quarter and period ended 30 September 2024 are available on the Company's website (www.pdsltd.com) and on the websites of BSE and NSE.Previous period figures have been re-grouped or reclassified where necessary to conform to the current period's classification, with no material impact from these changes.
